response.headline: Hire the Maintenance Coordinator now; Operations Associate hire not currently affordable
response.summary: Finance and HR data converge on a single actionable hire: the Maintenance Coordinator role, which is both budget-approved and addresses a real capacity gap (maintenance is over_capacity, role open 63 days vs 38-day average). This fits within Finance's verified limit of 1 affordable additional hire. The Operations Associate role, while also justified by HR's over_capacity and overtime data (180 hours), remains pending_budget and would require a second hire — which exceeds the affordable-hire ceiling computed from Finance's available budget. There is no disagreement in principle between Finance and HR; the deciding factor is the hard constraint that only 1 hire is currently fundable, and that hire should go to the role that already has approved budget.
response.financePerspective: Finance confirms at most 1 additional hire is affordable this fiscal year (52,000 EUR available vs 48,000 EUR benchmark cost per hire). Operating margin (13.59%) and 8-month cash runway suggest no near-term cash pressure, but the 12% growth projection is unconfirmed revenue and should not justify hiring beyond the 1-hire limit. Finance has no visibility into which department or role needs headcount most.
response.hrPerspective: HR identifies two open roles: Maintenance Coordinator (budget-approved, open 63 days, in an over-capacity department with 96 overtime hours) and Operations Associate (pending budget approval, in an over-capacity department with 180 overtime hours). HR recommends proceeding with Maintenance Coordinator now and escalating budget approval for Operations Associate, but defers affordability confirmation to Finance.
conditions: Finalize the Maintenance Coordinator hire only, as it is the sole role with approved budget and fits within the 1 affordable additional hire.
Do not proceed with the Operations Associate hire until it receives budget approval AND Finance confirms affordability within the annual hiring budget — this would exceed the current 1-hire capacity.
Confirm actual compensation offer for Maintenance Coordinator against the 48,000 EUR benchmark to ensure it stays within the 52,000 EUR available budget.
risks: Benchmark cost per hire (48,000 EUR) is an assumption; actual Maintenance Coordinator compensation could exceed available budget (52,000 EUR), eliminating the hiring margin.
Operations remains over_capacity with 180 overtime hours and no funded relief, risking continued overtime costs, burnout, or turnover (voluntary turnover already at 11.8%).

Hiring a second person (Operations Associate) is not currently affordable per Finance's verified maximum of 1 additional hire; pursuing it without new budget approval would violate the approved annual hiring budget.
Growth projection (12%) used to rationalize expansion is not committed revenue and should not be used to justify hiring beyond the verified affordable limit.
missingInformation: Actual compensation offer for Maintenance Coordinator versus the 48,000 EUR benchmark.
Department-level cost allocation clarifying financial impact of hiring into Maintenance specifically.
Whether Operations Associate budget approval is likely or timeline for potential approval.
Skills matrix data to confirm whether Operations/Maintenance overtime stems from headcount shortage vs. skill gaps.
Any committed revenue pipeline to validate the 12% growth projection.
